$comment: Central publication allowlist — the single place that decides which posts reach readers. Each surface maps category -> "all" (every post) or an array of allowed `status` frontmatter values. Explicit allow only: a category or status missing from a surface publishes NOTHING there, so new categories and new shelf statuses stay off every feed until added here. `rss` governs the site-wide, per-category, and group RSS feeds; `syndication` governs POSSE cross-posting (Mastodon, Bluesky, Threads, Instagram). See docs/operations/publication.md.
